reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as the role of local chemical order (LCO) in modifying dislocation glide barriers and strength in concentrated alloys is well-supported by recent literature, though the exact quantification of the effect remains an active research area.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive: systematically vary LCO via annealing, quantify it with advanced techniques, and measure strength and deformation; a null result on strength increase would directly falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, non-trivial hypothesis that addresses a central debate in the field, providing a clear experimental framework to isolate LCO effects from other strengthening mechanisms.
